verdict.rationale: Not using customer data for training is a fair question for an inference API, so the axis applies. The pack has no data-retention or no-training policy and no training opt-out control. Dedicated endpoints offer private, reserved capacity, but that is about compute isolation, not training-data use, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
